strings.tut_combo_hint: Tap the arena really fast! Every hit fills this bar. Fill it to land your first kick.
strings.tut_goals: You reached a goal! Tap the trophy to claim your prize.
strings.tut_masks: You can afford a new mask! Each one gives a different edge. Open the Masks tab.
strings.belts_progress: Changing masks now would give you {n} belts. You need {min} to change.
strings.belts_info_prestige: 1. Change masks (red button): you go back to fight 1, but you earn belts. The more coins you earn before changing, the more you get. You can change once it is worth {n} or more.
strings.belts_info_goals: 2. Claim achievements, daily goals, the chest and the daily reward (tap the trophy).
strings.belts_info_shop: 3. Shop: buy packs or get one by watching an ad.
strings.belts_info_use: Belts buy talents (here) and masks. Every belt earned by changing masks also adds damage forever.
strings.boss_ready: You can take the boss now! Tap BOSS!
strings.tut_talents: You can raise a talent! They are permanent boosts paid with belts. Open the Talents tab.
strings.tut_panel_toggle: This button switches the list: upgrades for your wrestler or trainers who fight for you. It shows a dot when the other list has something you can buy.
strings.tut_skill_learn: Tap the Body Splash's price to learn it. Every level makes it stronger.
strings.tut_skill_back: Learned! Tap here to go back to the fight.
strings.tut_skill_use: Here are your skills. Tap a button to use it; then it needs a few seconds to recharge.
strings.tut_goals_login: At the top is the daily reward: come back every day and claim it. Miss a day and your streak just waits.
strings.tut_goals_daily: Here are today's goals: finish all three and open the chest. Don't like one? You can swap it.
strings.tut_goals_achievements: Below are the achievements: longer challenges that pay coins and belts.
strings.tut_goals_claim: This prize is ready! Tap "Claim" to get it.
strings.tut_back: Tap here to go back to the fight.
strings.tut_masks_tour: Tap a mask to see its bonus and price. Masks cost belts; the one you wear gives you its bonus.
strings.tut_talents_tour: Each talent is a boost forever. Pick one and tap "Upgrade" (they cost belts).
strings.tut_prestige_tour: Tap "Change mask": you go back to fight 1 without upgrades or trainers, but you earn belts and keep your masks and talents.
strings.tut_goals_back: You claimed your prize! Now back to the fight: tap here.
